# MM-P1-L4-CN01 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat CNC turning center #1

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-CN01

Scope
- Routine mechanical and operational maintenance for EQ-P1-L4-CN01 in P1-L4 heat treat cell.
- Tasks cover chuck jaw bolt verification, spindle warm-up procedure, and visual inspections required before production handoff.
- Refer to MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2, SB-1046, SOP-P1-L4-01 for related procedures and safety bulletins.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated for specified chuck jaw bolt torque.
- Manufacturer-approved cleaning brushes and lint-free wipes.
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P1-L4-01.
- Routine inspection lamp and mirror.

Procedure
- Verify machine is in a stopped and locked state following SOP-P1-L4-01 before any mechanical work.
- Inspect chuck, jaws, and mounting surfaces for foreign material; remove debris with lint-free wipes.
- For chuck jaw bolt verification: set torque wrench to 90 N·m and sequentially verify each chuck jaw bolt reaches specified torque. Do not exceed or under-torque bolts.
- Close chuck and cycle manually to confirm smooth travel and repeatability; correct any binding per MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2.
- Perform spindle warm-up following the warm-up schedule in the controller: run warm-up cycle until spindle has completed the programmed ramp. Ensure cumulative spindle warm-up time equals 15 minutes before loading production parts.
- After warm-up, perform a light test cut on a sacrificial workpiece per SB-1046 to confirm surface finish and concentricity.
- Record all findings, torque readings, and any corrective actions in the maintenance log and notify line supervision if out-of-tolerance conditions are found.

Acceptance criteria
- All chuck jaw bolts verified at 90 N·m.
- Spindle has completed a 15 minutes warm-up and controller indicates ready state per SOP-P1-L4-01.
- Test cut meets dimensional and surface criteria referenced in SB-1046.
- Maintenance log completed and cross-referenced to MM-P1-L4-CN01-S2.
